text_blocks.snippet: The "best" treatment for COVID-19 depends on individual risk factors and symptom severity, but antiviral medications like Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir and ritonavir) and Lagevrio (molnupiravir) are effective for those at higher risk of severe illness. It's crucial to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the most appropriate course of action.

list.title: Paxlovid:
list.snippet: An oral antiviral that can help reduce the risk of severe illness and hospitalization in high-risk individuals.

list.title: Lagevrio:
list.snippet: Another oral antiviral option for mild to moderate COVID-19 in high-risk individuals.

list.title: Early Treatment:
list.snippet: Antiviral medications are most effective when started soon after symptom onset, so it's essential to seek medical advice promptly if you test positive for COVID-19.

list.title: Individualized Approach:
list.snippet: The best treatment plan will vary based on factors such as age, vaccination status, underlying health conditions, and the severity of symptoms.

list.title: Rebound Symptoms:
list.snippet: Some individuals may experience a return of symptoms after completing antiviral treatment, but this is typically mild and resolves on its own.

list.title: Consult with a Doctor:
list.snippet: Always consult with a healthcare professional to discuss your specific situation and determine the most appropriate treatment plan, according to the CDC.
